Name: Fish-2-Seed Processor
Author: socialcoder
Description:
Convert fish and crustaceans into specific crop seeds! The "Fish-2-Seed Processor" requires 1 trash, 1 driftwood, 1 soggy newspaper, 1 broken CD, and 1 broken glasses to build and is immediately available to craft. This is a great mod for those that want to do "no store" or "no seed purchase" runs, or just would like fishing to be a little more interesting and rewarding by having the ability to convert fish into farmable crops which will often be the more profitable option.

[list]
[*]Nearly all fish will convert to a seed compatible (plantable) within the season in which they are able to be caught with only a tiny few exceptions.
[*]Processing time takes 60 minutes of in-game time.
[*]Most seeds will be obtainable from common fish/crustaceans save for super high value seeds like Starfruit and Rare Seed. I did my best to balance things so you have to hunt for rarer fish in order to get better/higher-value seeds. See the spoiler below if you'd like to know all the fish/crustacean conversions. Since crustaceans are also part of this mod, it makes investing in crab pots more worthwhile.
[*]Year 2 crop seeds can be obtained from fish caught in your first year. 
[*]Fish/crustaceans that convert to Spring Seeds, Summer seeds, or Fall Seeds will always convert to 3 seeds, increasing by 3 with each level of quality so a normal fish will provide 3 season seeds, a silver fish will convert to 6 season seeds, a gold fish will convert to 9 seeds, and an iridium fish will convert to 12 season seeds. The fish that convert to Winter Seeds will provide 5 seeds increasing by 5 with each increase in quality, so a normal fish will convert to 5 Winter Seeds, a silver fish will convert to 10 Winter Seeds, a gold fish will convert to 15 Winter Seeds, and an iridium fish will convert to 20 Winter Seeds (I opted for Winter fish to provide more Winter Seeds since there's not much farming to do in Winter).
[*]Every other fish/crustacean will convert to seeds in the following way: normal and silver = 1 seed, gold = 2 seeds, iridium = 3 seeds.
[*]Legendary Fish will provide significant rewards in the form of high stacks of rare/high-value seeds to make them worth processing over selling.
[*]Seaweed and Green Algae can be put into the processor to generate 5 bait.
[/list]
Please provide me with any feedback you'd like. I can also perhaps update some fish to convert to more seeds if people feel it's still not worth the effort. Please let me know if you experience any bugs or have any suggestions.
